Fitter Function for Residual-Augmented IVX Models

Source: R/ivx-ra.R
ivx_ra_fit.Rd

Basic function called by ivx_ra to fit the model. Should only be used directly by experienced users.

Usage

ivx_ra_fit(
  y,
  x,
  ar = "auto",
  ar_ic = "aic",
  ar_max = 5,
  horizon = 1,
  beta = 0.95,
  cz = 1,
  ...
)

Arguments

y

vector of observations of length n, or a matrix with n rows.

x

design matrix of dimension n * p.

ar

order of the autoregression fitted to the predictors: "auto" selects it by ar_ic in levels (as recommended in the paper), or a positive integer for a fixed order.

ar_ic

information criterion for ar = "auto".

ar_max

maximum order considered when ar = "auto".

horizon

forecast horizon \(h\); see Details.

beta, cz

tuning parameters of the IVX instrument \(z_t = \sum_{j=0}^{t-1} (1 - c_z/n^\beta)^j \Delta x_{t-j}\). Defaults (beta = 0.95, cz = 1) follow Kostakis et al. (2015).

...

currently unused.

Examples

ivx_ra_fit(kms$Ret, as.matrix(kms$DP))
